canonical_name: Analysis Not Performed to Establish What Took Place and Root Cause
description: Analysis is not performed to establish what has taken place and the root cause.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify incidents closed without root cause analysis documentation, missing timeline reconstruction, incomplete attack chain mapping, or incidents lacking determination of initial attack vector. Monitor for cases where remediation occurs without understanding underlying vulnerabilities or configuration weaknesses that enabled the incident.
